2609.10125.title: SA-Profile: Automated Sulcus Angle Profiling from Super-Resolution MRI
2609.10125.paper_summary: Trochlear dysplasia (TD) is an abnormality of the femoral trochlea associated with anterior knee pain and patellar instability. The sulcus angle (SA) is used to assess trochlear morphology, but it is typically measured on a single axial MR slice with no clear guidance on which to select, making it sensitive to slice selection and landmark placement. We propose an automatic framework for continuous SA profiling from super-resolved MR volumes. Clinically acquired axial, coronal, and sagittal MR scans are combined using implicit neural representations to reconstruct a high-resolution volume. SA measurements are computed across the trochlear region using two landmark detection U-Net models. The approach was evaluated on the public fastMRI dataset and a small in-house cohort of patients with TD. Compared with conventional manual single-slice SA measurements, the proposed automated method yielded a mean absolute error of 11.6$^\circ$ while providing continuous characterization of trochlear morphology. Population-level analysis demonstrated distinct mean SA profiles between the public cohort and the in-house TD cohort, highlighting the potential of profile-based assessment to characterize TD. By reducing reliance on a single manually selected axial slice, the proposed framework extends conventional SA assessment to a continuous profile-based description of trochlear morphology without additional imaging, while remaining conceptually linked to current clinical assessment. Further validation is required. The code is available: https://github.com/wehrlimi/SA_Profile.
2609.10125.paper_summary_zh: 股骨滑車發育不良（TD）是一種與前膝痛和髕骨不穩定性相關的滑車異常。溝角（SA）用於評估滑車形態，但通常是在單一的軸向磁共振切片上測量，並且沒有明確的指導選擇哪一個切片，使其對切片選擇和標誌物放置非常敏感。我們提出了一個自動化框架，用於從超解析的磁共振體積中持續進行SA輪廓分析。臨床獲取的軸向、冠狀面和矢狀面磁共振掃描使用隱式神經表示法進行結合，以重建高解析度的體積。SA測量通過兩個標誌物檢測U-Net模型在滑車區域進行計算。該方法在公共的fastMRI數據集和一小組TD患者的內部隊列上進行了評估。與傳統的手動單切片SA測量相比，所提出的自動化方法產生了11.6$^\circ$的平均絕對誤差，同時提供了滑車形態的持續特徵描述。人口水平的分析顯示公共隊列和內部TD隊列之間存在明顯的平均SA輪廓差異，突顯了基於輪廓的評估在特徵化TD方面的潛力。通過減少對單一手動選擇的軸向切片的依賴，所提出的框架將傳統的SA評估擴展到滑車形態的持續基於輪廓的描述，無需額外的成像，同時仍然在概念上與當前的臨床評估相關。進一步的驗證是必要的。代碼可在此獲得：https://github.com/wehrlimi/SA_Profile。
